# Findly — Design Notes

## Source

- ColorLib: Search 16 (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/colorlib-search-16/)
- Preview: https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/colorlib-search-16/
- Description: Modern and responsive free travel services search template

## Tokens

- Primary: `#e8a838` (warm amber/gold)
- Primary hover: `#d49530`
- Background: `#faf7f2` (warm off-white)
- Dark text: `#1a1a2e`
- Muted text: `#6b7280`
- Font: Poppins (Google Fonts)
- Border radius: rounded-xl for form elements
- Shadows: shadow-lg on search card

## Layout

1. Sticky navbar with Compass icon logo, nav links (Destinations, Deals, About), Book Now CTA
2. Full-page hero with gradient background and centered search card
3. Search card: horizontal form with Going To (with MapPin icon), Check-In, Check-Out, Guests counter, Search button
4. Dark footer with Compass icon, copyright, Component Dock link
